indicator_name: Goods imports by HS chapter (2 digits), thousand USD, monthly
description: Импорт товаров по группам (главам) ТН ВЭД ЕАЭС, тыс. долларов США, помесячно
methodology: National. TOTAL is the published national row; a chapter is the sum of its 6-digit lines over the regional blocks (months whose lines miss the national row keep TOTAL only). HS99 = code 999999 «Прочие товары»; chapter 93 is not published. Raw file: bns_imports_2026-09-15.xlsx.
